// A worker process for the concurrent-reservation race test: its own connection to the same database file,
// used because concurrent HTTP calls into one synchronous connection would pass without ever racing (TS §12.5).
import { existsSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { openDb, writeTx } from "../../src/platform/db.ts";
import { insertLoan } from "../../src/features/loans/loans.repository.ts";

const [dbPath, itemId, userId, dir] = process.argv.slice(2);
const db = openDb(dbPath!);
try {
  writeFileSync(join(dir!, `ready-${userId}`), "");
  const deadline = Date.now() + 18_000;
  while (!existsSync(join(dir!, "start"))) {
    if (Date.now() >= deadline) throw new Error("start barrier timed out");
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 10));
  }
  await writeTx(db, () => {
    if (!db.inTransaction) throw new Error("reservation insert outside the write transaction");
    insertLoan(db, { id: `${userId}-loan`, item_id: itemId!, user_id: userId!, reserved_at: Date.now() });
  });
  process.stdout.write("ok");
} catch (e) {
  process.stdout.write((e as { code?: string }).code === "SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_UNIQUE" ? "conflict" : `error:${String(e)}`);
} finally {
  db.close();
}
